data.title: Earn Attention, Don't Fight for It: Netflix and Music Chiefs on Asia's Creative Boom
data.description: At CNN's Bangkok forum, Netflix and Pacific Music Group leaders say local authenticity, not global chasing, is turning Asian talent into worldwide influence

data.title: Fiji village restores dying fishery with coral planting
data.description: NAIDIRI - It had been decades since sharks last patrolled the reef off the coast of Fiji’s Naidiri Village, but they returned this year following a community-led effort to protect the fishery and plant thousands of corals.

data.title: Japan reports record number of foreign residents
data.description: TOKYO - Japan has registered a record number of foreigners living in the country this year despite growing anti-immigration sentiment, as the country grapples with problems caused by an ageing and shrinking population.

data.title: North Korea reports test of AI-assisted torpedo system
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea has tested a “new-type” precision-guided torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance, state media reported on Saturday, as the nuclear-armed country steps up weapons testing.

data.title: UN climate panel fails to agree date for global warming update
data.description: PARIS - The UN's IPCC climate panel failed after a week of tough talks to reach an agreement on when to release its next report on global warming, the senior French envoy at the talks said Friday.

data.title: Korn urges govt to take action on scams
data.description: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij has urged the government to step up its fight against scam networks, warning that international cooperation means little without action at home.

data.title: Households in NE economically vulnerable: poll
data.description: The household economy in the northeastern region was "vulnerable" during the third quarter, with no expectations of improvement for the rest of the year, a recent poll found.

data.title: Minister apologises over e-harvester price blunder
data.description: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has apologised for mistakenly quoting 16 million baht per electric harvester, insisting the ministry has no plans to buy the machines.

data.description: Ouijai Chaisri was hoping to mark her 44th birthday on Oct 7, 2023, when Hamas launched its attacks on Israel, reshaping the Middle East.

data.title: Flood woes for the PP
data.description: The devastating floods that paralysed large parts of Bangkok have revived a familiar but consequential question in Thai politics: What exactly do voters expect from their elected MPs when a crisis strikes?

data.title: Cumbia comin' on strong
data.description: On the website of the Baltimore-based cumbia band Soroche is a big caps statement, "Cumbia Is The New Punk". This cumbia "fusion" outfit mixes cumbia, punk, ska, folk, a bit of rock'n'roll and anything else that takes their fancy into a heady Tropical concoction, or as the band puts it, "a danceable alchemy that crosses cultural dancefloors".

data.title: Hubs ofinnovation
data.description: The Thailand Creative & Design Center (TCDC) officially opened in 2005 and launched its services to the public the following day. Operated by the Creative Economy Agency, it connects creators while promoting creativity, skills, cultural assets and businesses to help people develop quality products and services that meet global market demands.

data.title: Choi holds firm, Jeeno trails by four
data.description: SHANGHAI: Choi Hye-Jin maintained a two-stroke lead after the second round of the LPGA Shanghai tournament yesterday, while defending champion Jeeno Thitikul was four shots off the pace.

data.title: Leaders Manchester City's progress comes with an asterisk
data.description: There is a rather strange atmosphere in the Premier League at the moment as a direct result of the Manchester City situation. It is a period of uncertainty which is likely to continue until we know the outcome of City's appeal against financial malfeasance. It gets even foggier with the Citizens sitting on top of the table and looking like one of the strongest candidates for the title.

data.title: Asia's elite players vie for AFC honours in Bangkok
data.description: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) yesterday unveiled a list of nominees for the AFC Awards Bangkok 2026, which is slated to take place on Nov 19.

data.title: Norasetthada smashes national record
data.description: Thailand's Norasetthada Bunma broke the national record for the men's 1km time trial at the UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai yesterday, clocking one minute 2.987 seconds to finish 24th in a field of 30.

data.title: Anutin calls for global cooperation
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul called on countries to work together to tackle rapid global change as he formally opened the plenary session of the IMF-World Bank annual meetings.

data.title: Academic asks why the BMA overlooked projects
data.description: A Kasetsart University academic has questioned why Bangkok allocated more than 34 billion baht to flood prevention over two years while omitting six major eastern water-retention projects from its action plans.

data.title: Govt urged to rethink tax allocations
data.description: Movendi International has urged Thailand to abandon plans to scrap its earmarked tax system, warning that the move could expose public health policies to political interference and pressure from the alcohol and tobacco industries.

data.title: Pathum sunk at home as Adelaide snatch winner
data.description: BG Pathum United remain winless in the AFC Champions League Two after they went down at home to Adelaide United 2-1 at Pathum Thani Stadium on Thursday night.

data.title: Bend grieves after mass shooting: 'Who would do this to little kids?'
data.description: BEND (UNITED STATES) - Kristen Vanetsky and her family moved to Bend, Oregon, after a shooting in their New Mexico neighborhood, choosing Silver Rail elementary for her grandson because they considered it safer.

data.title: 'Great hero' praised for saving lives in Oregon school shooting
data.description: BEND (UNITED STATES) - The "hero" who shot dead a teenage gunman after he had already killed three children and a teacher at an elementary school in the US state of Oregon was named Friday by his brother.

data.title: Macron calls for calm amid fears of violence at France protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - President Emmanuel Macron called for calm on the eve of nationwide cost-of-living protests Saturday that authorities fear could lead to a violent escalation of weeks of student demonstrations.

data.title: Clashes grip Tirana as Albanian PM blames 'foreign hands'
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Protesters clashed with police in Albania’s capital for the fourth day Friday as Prime Minister Edi Rama blamed "foreign hands" for mounting unrest.

data.title: EU backs Ukraine on Starlink, but can't fill gap
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - The European Union has pledged to help Ukraine with its dependence on Starlink satellite communications to support battlefield operations, but the bloc is a long way from being able to match the US-owned system.

data.title: US budget deficit grows to nearly $2 trillion, highest since 2021
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US budget deficit grew to almost $2 trillion over the past year, government data showed Friday, reaching its highest level since 2021 despite President Donald Trump's promises to cut public spending.

data.title: Trump says armed bystander who killed US school shooter a 'great hero'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump on Friday praised the armed bystander who shot dead a teenage gunman at an Oregon elementary school as a "great hero," saying the situation could have been "much worse."

data.title: All contenders for UN chief receive veto: diplomat
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - All seven candidates to lead the United Nations received a vote of "discourage," effectively a veto, from a permanent UN Security Council member in the latest informal poll, a diplomat said Friday.

data.title: India detains top ‘cockroach’ leader again
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian police detained Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leader Abhijeet Dipke on Friday ahead of fresh protests demanding the removal of the country’s election chief, the youth-led movement said in a social media post.
